---
title: "R Notebook"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(tidyverse)

folder_path <- "datasets/G_lists_dataset"

csv_files <- list.files(path = folder_path, pattern = "*.csv", full.names = TRUE)

combined_data <- csv_files %>%
  map_dfr(~ read_delim(.x, delim = ";"))

df_loan_summary <- combined_data |>
  filter(Hist_status == "loan", !is.na(Class_label)) |>
  group_by(Lexeme, Class_label) |>
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(Lexeme) |>
  mutate(
    total = sum(n),
    pct = 100 * n / total
  ) |>
  ungroup()

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

#summary of a, e and hybrid across verbs
df_loan_summary <- combined_data |>
  filter(Hist_status == "loan", !is.na(Class_label)) |>
  group_by(Lexeme, Class_label) |>
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(Lexeme) |>
  mutate(
    total = sum(n),
    pct = 100 * n / total
  ) |>
  ungroup()

df_loan_summary <- df_loan_summary %>%
  mutate(
    Lexeme = dplyr::case_when(
      Lexeme == "bruka" ~ "bruka 'use'",
      Lexeme == "hakka" ~ "hakka 'chop'",
      Lexeme == "klaga"  ~ "klaga 'complain'",
      Lexeme == "koka"  ~ "koka 'cook'",
      Lexeme == "para"  ~ "para 'pair'",
      Lexeme == "pela" ~ "pela 'pick, peel'",
      Lexeme == "r\u00E5ka" ~ "r\u00E5ka 'hit, encounter'",
      Lexeme == "snakka" ~ "snakka 'talk, speak'",
      Lexeme == "spela"  ~ "spela 'play'",
      Lexeme == "streva"  ~ "streva 'struggle, strive'",
      TRUE              ~ Lexeme   # fallback if something is missing
    )
  )



ggplot(df_loan_summary,
       aes(x = Lexeme,
           y = pct,
           fill = Class_label)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, colour = "black") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = n),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),  
    color = "white",
    size  = 4
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name   = "Class category",
    values = c("a" = "#BDBDBD", "e" = "#2F2F2F", "hybrid" = "#0072B2" ),
    labels = c("a" = "\"pure\" a", "e" = "\"pure\" e", "hybrid" = "mixed")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Lexeme",
    y = "Percentage of paradigms"
  )  +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 14)
  )


```
